title: The Counter-Narrative: The Arab Revolt Onscreen
author: Ed Rampell
content:
Cinema has spawned great feature films dramatizing the Arab Revolt, including
David Lean’s 1962 Lawrence of Arabia, which won seven Oscars, including Best
Picture and Best Director, and Gillo Pontecorvo’s 1966 The Battle of Algiers,
which received three Oscar nominations. Now we can add to this prestigious
list Palestine 36, Palestine’s official selection for Best International
Feature at the 98th Academy Awards and winner of the Tokyo International Film
Festival’s Best Film Award.
